---
name: Feature request · 功能建议
about: Suggest an engine/UI/preset capability / 建议一个引擎、界面或预设能力
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem / 要解决的问题**

What are you trying to do that is awkward or impossible today? (Start from the player or card-author experience — see the README's design principles.) / 今天想做什么但很别扭或做不到?(从玩家或卡作者的体验讲起。)

**Proposal / 方案设想**

What should exist instead? If it involves new concepts, check first whether it fits the project direction — everything folds back into local scripts + the agent harness. / 希望存在什么?若涉及新概念,先看是否贴合项目方向——一切收口回本地脚本 + agent 基础设施。

**Alternatives / 备选方案**

Any SillyTavern extension, card convention, or existing preset pattern that covers part of this today (helps map to the import path). / 现有 ST 扩展、卡约定或 preset 范式里已覆盖部分需求的(便于映射到导入路径)。
